## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: openspec validate accepts a proposal intent block whose owner resolves in...

The system SHALL ensure that openspec validate accepts a proposal intent block whose owner resolves in the ownership map and rejects one whose owner does not.

#### Scenario: openspec validate accepts a proposal intent block whose owner resolves in...

WHEN `owned-intent-blocks` is implemented
THEN openspec validate accepts a proposal intent block whose owner resolves in the ownership map and rejects one whose owner does not.

### Requirement: A PR that edits another owner's intent block without an accepted amendment...

The system SHALL ensure that a PR that edits another owner's intent block without an accepted amendment fails the intent-ownership check.

#### Scenario: A PR that edits another owner's intent block without an accepted amendment...

WHEN `owned-intent-blocks` is implemented
THEN A PR that edits another owner's intent block without an accepted amendment fails the intent-ownership check.

### Requirement: An agent encountering two principals' conflicting intents emits a conflict...

The system SHALL ensure that an agent encountering two principals' conflicting intents emits a conflict escalation naming both owners and makes no choice between them.

#### Scenario: An agent encountering two principals' conflicting intents emits a conflict...

WHEN `owned-intent-blocks` is implemented
THEN An agent encountering two principals' conflicting intents emits a conflict escalation naming both owners and makes no choice between them.

### Requirement: Proposals without an intent block, and repositories without owners.yaml,...

The system SHALL ensure that proposals without an intent block, and repositories without owners.yaml, validate and merge exactly as before.

#### Scenario: Proposals without an intent block, and repositories without owners.yaml,...

WHEN `owned-intent-blocks` is implemented
THEN Proposals without an intent block, and repositories without owners.yaml, validate and merge exactly as before.
